rules.statement: The added defendant's possession of the property was not sufficient to establish adverse possession under Ceylon law.
rules.supporting_quote: 'In my opinion he has not done so. He admits that he was "given charge of the house." That being so, it is for him to show that his quasi fiduciary position was changed by some overt act to possession, i.e., a holding with the intention of keeping the property to himself. This he has failed to do.'
